title: wg: protocol-06 endpoint /v1 prefix and placeholder expansion unspecified
description: draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06: (1) §5.1 example paths carry /v1 but §5.2ff endpoint text has no prefix; (2) directory placeholders like {targetUser} have no defined expansion/encoding rule (RFC 6570?). Report to the MIMI WG. Our readings: decisions mimid-1wgh.5.37 and mimid-1wgh.5.38.
